# MS Chi-Cheemaun

The 2026 Sailing Season has ended.

Reservations open March 2027.

## Routes

* * *

Our seasonal ferry service offers a dependable connection between local communities in northern and southwestern Ontario.

Please note the 2026 Sailing Season for the Tobermory / Manitoulin Island and the Moosonee / Moose Factory Island routes has closed.

[Read more](https://www.ontarioferries.com/routes)

[![A hiker with a backpack stands on a cliff edge, gazing over a vast green forest. Distant wind turbines and a lake are visible under a bright blue sky.](https://www.ontarioferries.com/sites/default/files/styles/3_2_small/public/images/Tobermory%20Manitoulin%20Island%20Op%20Card.png.avif?itok=O38tBVtv)](https://www.ontarioferries.com/routes/tobermory-manitoulin-island-ferry)

### Tobermory  Manitoulin Island

Venture into the heart of Canada's wilderness with daily ferry service connecting Manitoulin Island and the Bruce Peninsula aboard the Chi-Cheemaun.

Book Now [View Details](https://www.ontarioferries.com/routes/tobermory-manitoulin-island-ferry)

[![A peninsula extends into vast blue water, reflecting bright sunlight. Rectangular fields and trees cover the land, with small islands visible in the distance under a partly cloudy sky.](https://www.ontarioferries.com/sites/default/files/styles/3_2_small/public/images/Pelee%20Island%20Sandusky%20Op%20Card.png.avif?itok=zXittkDH)](https://www.ontarioferries.com/routes/pelee-island)

### Leamington/Kingsville  Pelee Island  Sandusky

Sail the western basin of Lake Erie to the sundrenched vineyards and scenic shores of Pelee Island aboard the Pelee Islander ferries.

[Book Now](https://www.ontarioferries.com/book) [View Details](https://www.ontarioferries.com/routes/pelee-island)

[![scenic view of Niska route](https://www.ontarioferries.com/sites/default/files/styles/3_2_small/public/images/Scenic.jpg.avif?itok=55Vo_3jG)](https://www.ontarioferries.com/routes/moosonee-moose-factory-island)

### Moosonee  Moose Factory Island

Our landing craft-style vessel offers passenger and vehicle transport across the Moose River to Ontario's oldest trading post aboard the Niska.

Book Now [View Details](https://www.ontarioferries.com/routes/moosonee-moose-factory-island)

![Lake Erie](https://www.ontarioferries.com/sites/default/files/styles/scale/public/images/d813e233c85882cbe462876846ad9f6b0bd7771d.jpg.avif?itok=J1FpOORV)

## Schedule & Fares

Review passenger and vehicle fares, explore upcoming sailings, and start planning your journey with us.

[![White ferry "Chi-Cheemaun", adorned with colorful Indigenous artwork and "TRAVEL IN GOOD SPIRITS", cruises on calm water. Autumn trees line the shore under a blue, cloudy sky.](https://www.ontarioferries.com/sites/default/files/styles/3_2_small/public/images/Chi-cheemaun%20hero.jpg.avif?itok=Qd3Udz8k)](https://www.ontarioferries.com/routes/tobermory-manitoulin-island-ferry/schedule)

MS Chi-Cheemaun

### MS Chi-Cheemaun Sailing Schedule

Explore daily sailings between Manitoulin Island and the Bruce Peninsula.

[See Sailings](https://www.ontarioferries.com/routes/tobermory-manitoulin-island-ferry/schedule) [Check Fares](https://www.ontarioferries.com/routes/tobermory-manitoulin-island-ferry/fares-tickets)

MV Pelee Islander & MV Pelee Islander II

### Pelee Island Sailing Schedule

Explore daily sailings between Pelee Island and the mainland ports of Leamington and Kingsville, as well as Sandusky, Ohio.

[See Sailings](https://www.ontarioferries.com/routes/pelee-island/schedule) [Check Fares](https://www.ontarioferries.com/routes/pelee-island/fares-tickets)

MV Niska I

### MV Niska I Sailing Schedule

Explore weekday sailings between Moosonee and Moose Factory Island.

[See Sailings](https://www.ontarioferries.com/routes/moosonee-moose-factory-island/schedule) [Check Fares](https://www.ontarioferries.com/routes/moosonee-moose-factory-island/fares-tickets)

## Offers

* * *

Set sail into savings with preferred rates for groups and frequent travellers, and explore upcoming events, onboard programming, and community celebrations.

[Explore All](https://www.ontarioferries.com/offers)

[![Five people in colorful Adirondack chairs sit on a deck, looking out at a vast blue lake towards a distant forested shore. One uses binoculars, another a phone; a beanie reads "ISLANDS".](https://www.ontarioferries.com/sites/default/files/styles/3_2_small/public/images/Chi-cheemaun%20observation%20deck.jpg.avif?itok=8X_vZuo6)](https://www.ontarioferries.com/offers/group-discount)

MS Chi-Cheemaun, MV Pelee Islander & MV Pelee Islander II

### Group Discount

Travelling in a large group aboard the MS Chi-Cheemaun or Pelee Island Ferries? Take advantage of 10% savings on passenger fares when you book and travel as a single reservation.

[Learn More](https://www.ontarioferries.com/offers/group-discount)

[![Vessel on the water](https://www.ontarioferries.com/sites/default/files/styles/3_2_small/public/images/8b2f69de2fa90fdb9aad1944dbf27c54b142ea4c%202.jpg.avif?itok=SEsOOGfx)](https://www.ontarioferries.com/offers/frequent-sailor-discount)

MV Pelee Islander & MV Pelee Islander II

### Frequent Sailor Discount

Pelee Island residents can take advantage of special discounted rates for frequent sailors. Submit your application and enjoy a savings of 15% on passenger and vehicle fares including winter air service.

[Learn More](https://www.ontarioferries.com/offers/frequent-sailor-discount)

[![A person stands on a ferry deck, looking at the wake and distant horizon at sunset. Colorful chairs and wooden benches line the deck.](https://www.ontarioferries.com/sites/default/files/styles/3_2_small/public/images/Lifestyle%20-%20back%20of%20ship.jpg.avif?itok=xQbC-Glm)](https://www.ontarioferries.com/offers/ms-chi-cheemauns-loyalty-stamp-card)

MS Chi-Cheemaun

### MS Chi-Cheemaun's Loyalty Stamp Card

Set sail into savings aboard the MS Chi-Cheemaun with a Loyalty Stamp Card, available at ferry terminals in Tobermory, Bruce Peninsula and South Baymouth, Manitoulin Island. Collect stamps throughout the sailing season and enjoy your 10th vehicle crossing on us.

[Learn More](https://www.ontarioferries.com/offers/ms-chi-cheemauns-loyalty-stamp-card)

## Our Story

* * *

We’ve been sailing Ontario’s waterways for more than a hundred years, from the launch of our first ship in 1921, to the maiden voyage of the MS Chi-Cheemaun in 1974, to the legacy of marine excellence we proudly steward today.

[Learn More](https://www.ontarioferries.com/our-story)

# MV Niska 1

Slide 1 of 1: MV Niska 1

* * *

Small yet mighty, the MV Niska 1 offers a safe, reliable link across the Moose River, connecting Moose Factory Island with Moosonee—the Gateway to the Arctic. Operated in partnership with Moose Cree First Nation, the landing craft-style vessel provides essential ferry transportation for passengers, vehicles, and commercial freight in one of Ontario's oldest and most historic communities.

![A white vehicle ferry, "Ontario NISKA II P-1", carries two semi-trucks, docked at a dirt ramp connecting to a wide river with distant forest, under a cloudy sky. A person sits on the bank.](https://www.ontarioferries.com/sites/default/files/styles/3_2_small/public/images/Niska%201.jpg.avif?itok=6iah6qsN)

## Quick Ferry Facts

- Moosonee ↔ Moose Factory Island
- Crossing Time: 18 minutes
- Capacity: 47 passengers, mixed vehicle/freight loads
- Size: 27 meters (88.5 feet) long with a 10.5-meter (35-foot) beam
- Service Speed: 6–10 knots
- Draft: 1.2 meters
- Power: 714 kilowatt

![Ferry deck with yellow lines extends between two white superstructures. One displays "Ontario" and a Canadian flag. It's by water and distant land under a blue, cloudy sky.](https://www.ontarioferries.com/sites/default/files/styles/3_2_small/public/images/Niska%20vehicle%20deck.jpg.avif?itok=Wf3YyOG0)

## Onboard Amenities

The MV Niska 1 is a “no frills” ferry service. Designed for a short, 18-minute commute across the Moose River, the open-deck vessel does not offer washroom facilities, onboard dining, or an indoor passenger lounge.

![Boat on the Moose River](https://www.ontarioferries.com/sites/default/files/styles/3_2_small/public/images/02%20Landscape%20-%20Moose%20River.jpg.avif?itok=OhQv68z5)

## History of the MV Niska 1

The MV Niska 1 entered service in 2010, replacing the aging Manitou Island II, which had served the Moose River for decades. The vessel was specifically designed as a landing craft—a nod to the birch bark canoes used by the Cree for centuries—with a shallow draft suited to river navigation. Named the Niska (Cree for "Goose"), the ferry is operated through a partnership with Moose Cree First Nation.

## MV Niska 1 FAQ

### Are walk-ons allowed?

Yes, walk-on passengers are generally allowed, however no other vehicle(s) or walk-on passengers are allowed on the vessel with propane/fuel or gas delivery trucks (dangerous goods runs).

### Can I pay with cash?

No, the MV Niska 1 operates as a cashless environment. We accept Visa, Mastercard, Amex, and Debit at the Complex and on the ferry.

### What is your dangerous goods policy?

The MV Niska 1 runs dedicated Dangerous Goods sailings. For safety, **no passengers are permitted on Dangerous Goods sailings**. The only exception is the certified operator of the vehicle carrying the dangerous goods.
